name: orcaslicer-agentlink
description: Drive OrcaSlicer from Claude, headless: projects changed at every level, painted, sliced, exported, the G-code read back, calibration prints built.
long_description: Runs Agent Link for OrcaSlicer (github.com/jamesK1000011/OrcaSlicer-AgentLink) with a Python already on this Mac: Homebrew's, python.org's, the Xcode tools', or FreeCAD's own. Finds OrcaSlicer in /Applications. No FreeCAD needed; with FreeCAD Agent Link installed too, its orca group adds work from FreeCAD bodies. LGPL-2.1-or-later. OrcaSlicer itself is AGPL-3.0 and runs as its own program.

out_dir.title: Output folder
out_dir.description: Where projects, G-code and exports go when a path is not given in full.

orca_app.title: OrcaSlicer
orca_app.description: Only if OrcaSlicer is not in /Applications: the path to its executable (OrcaSlicer.app/Contents/MacOS/OrcaSlicer).

auto_update.title: Keep it up to date
auto_update.description: At each start, fetch the newest Agent Link for OrcaSlicer from GitHub when it has changed.
